title: One Variable, Many Calls
prompt:
Implement `MakeCounter`: each call to the factory returns a FRESH `Func<int>` — invoking it returns 1, 2, 3, … for that instance. Two counters must not interfere.

```csharp
static Func<int> MakeCounter();
```

tests.name: independent instances
tests.hint: The count variable must live INSIDE the factory — one closure per call.
